name: ViDoRe v2
description: ViDoRe v2 raises the difficulty bar over the saturated v1 benchmark by introducing blind contextual querying (annotators see only document summaries, not full pages), long-form and cross-document queries, and an explicitly multilingual setup (English, French, Spanish, German). Covers 4 enterprise domains with 253 queries across 3,074 document pages.
reputation: Follow-up to the saturated ViDoRe v1; created specifically because top v1 models exceeded 90% nDCG@5. Hybrid human-and-synthetic annotation pipeline. One dataset (insurance) removed post-release for copyright reasons.
notes: 4 datasets: insurance (removed), biomedical/tissue interactions, economics/macro, ESG/restaurant reports. 3,074 pages, 909 qrels. Languages: EN, FR, ES, DE. Blind contextual querying reduces extractive bias by limiting annotator access to document metadata rather than full pages. arXiv:2505.17166.
